analysis_contract.decision_rule: Report effect sizes and confidence intervals regardless of p-value; primary claims require the pre-specified margin and multiplicity-adjusted inference.
analysis_contract.multiple_testing: Holm within each declared hypothesis family

boundary: Protocol evidence only. This freeze was created before independent-blind admission and formal adaptive results. It does not convert historical, diagnostic, running, or future incomplete runs into confirmatory evidence.

allowed_pre_run_exclusions: public task is provably incompatible with the declared tool/runtime interface
license or provider policy forbids execution
failure_and_exclusion_policy.duplicate_rows: hard error unless byte-identical resume evidence selects one canonical case manifest
failure_and_exclusion_policy.formal_cell_failure: any unresolved case failure blocks formal admission; repair requires rerunning all affected conditions, not selecting favorable cases
failure_and_exclusion_policy.missing_rows: hard error and formal admission blocked
failure_and_exclusion_policy.stopping_rule: complete the frozen universe; no optional early stopping based on effect direction
failure_and_exclusion_policy.threshold_tuning: validation only; no threshold changes after independent blind admission
failure_and_exclusion_policy.timeouts_parse_failures_max_steps: remain in the original denominator and are separately reported
